column1: # ApplyLabelSpec.java spec for /C132E0278.fullbin (2026-11-04): gear_shift_indicator_update is the gear shift indicator (GSI), not traction control.
# Its outputs reach only the cluster (gsi_flags bit2 up / bit6 down arrows); real TC is dpm_* (dpm_slip_calculator -> torque_limit_dpm_*).

column5: GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Points the GSI ratio / min-rpm tables at the IPS, close-ratio or long-ratio CALs by coding. Was init_slip_detection_limits.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. False if CAL_gsi_mode is disabled, VIN[9] (model year) < F with mode < 3, or IPS with mode 1. Was get_slip_indicator_mode.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. 100 ms GSI timers + smoothed steering-angle increase rate. Was slip_timers_and_steering_rate_100ms.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Steering-rate term + |lat_accel|, capped 255; shift advice suppressed when >= the cornering limit. Was tc_cornering_intensity.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Power-based upshift rpm from CAL_gsi_power_upshift_rpm[engine_power_corrected]. Was traction_power_based_rpm_threshold.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Added to the per-gear min rpm while cold (manual only), from CAL_gsi_coldstart_rpm_offset_manual[air mass since start]. Was traction_relax_factor_starting.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Highest gear whose rpm-at-current-speed exceeds its min rpm (CAL_gsi_min_rpm_*); above current gear -> upshift possible. Was traction_slip_detected_gear.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Highest gear whose rpm-at-current-speed exceeds gsi_power_upshift_rpm. Was traction_power_limit_gear.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Manual: latched moving flag for the display gear. Was tc_is_moving.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. IIR (<<8) of the 100 ms steering-angle increase. Was steering_angle_smoothed.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Smoothed steering-angle increase per 100 ms (1/10 deg, >>8 of the filter). Was traction_steering_increase_factor (not a /255 factor).
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Min time between recommended-gear changes. Was slip_gear_change_holdoff_timer.

GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Reloaded (CAL_gsi_pedal_applied_hold) while the pedal > CAL_gsi_pedal_applied_min; upshift advice needs it non-zero (or cruise). Was traction_inhibit_accel_pedal_timer.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Downshift advice delay (CAL_gsi_downshift_advisory_delay).
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Upshift advice delay (CAL_gsi_gear_qualify_time). Was traction_timer_per_gear_intervention.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Per gear: counts down while that gear meets both the min-rpm and power criteria; reloaded otherwise. Was traction_per_gear_timer100ms_intervention.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Gear latched while advice is shown (0xf = none). Write-only. Was tc_gear_tracker.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Recommended gear (0xf = none), limited to CAL_gsi_recommended_gear_max_step from the current gear. Write-only. Was tc_gear_recommended.

GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. bit0 current < min-rpm gear, bit1 current < power gear, bit2 UPSHIFT advice (cluster), bit3 front-wheel accel low, bit4 rpm below downshift point, bit5 lugging (manual), bit6 DOWNSHIFT advice (cluster). Was traction_flags.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Engine rpm each gear would give at the current speed: (speed - offset) * gear ratio / 1000. Was slip_expected_engine_rpm_per_gear.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. RAM pointers (not LEA) to the per-gear min-rpm CALs. Was LEA_slip_threshold_per_gear.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. RAM pointers (not LEA) to the per-gear ratio CALs. Was LEA_slip_gear_speed_ratios.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. rpm per km/h per gear (1/10), IPS. Was CAL_slip_gear_speed_ratios_ips.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. rpm per km/h per gear (1/10), close-ratio manual (COD[0] bit 16). Was CAL_slip_gear_speed_ratios_cr.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. rpm per km/h per gear (1/10), long-ratio manual. Was CAL_slip_gear_speed_ratios_long.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Min rpm in 1st (rpm = val*5 + 500; was typed *4). Was CAL_slip_threshold_1st_Gear.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Min rpm in gears 2-6, manual (rpm = val*5 + 500). Was CAL_slip_threshold_per_gear_manual.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Min rpm in gears 2-6, IPS (rpm = val*5 + 500). Was CAL_slip_slip_threshold_per_gear_ips.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. GSI mode (enum_slip_detect_mode); >2 also drives the cluster arrows. Was CAL_slip_detect_mode.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Pedal above this reloads gsi_pedal_applied_timer. Was CAL_slip_inhibit_accel_pedal_min.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Advice cancelled while |steering_angle| >= this. Was CAL_slip_timer_reset_steering_angle.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. A gear only qualifies while its rpm-at-speed < this. Was CAL_slip_expected_rpm_max.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Manual: min(speed, cal) subtracted from speed before rpm-in-gear. Was CAL_slip_threshold_car_speed.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Cold-start rpm offset applies while engine-off coolant < this. Was CAL_slip_coldstart_coolant_threshold.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Reload for gsi_gear_qualify_timer / gsi_upshift_advisory_timer (100 ms). Was CAL_slip_timer_per_gear_intervention.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Advice suppressed when gsi_cornering_intensity >= this. Was CAL_slip_inhibit_cornering_base.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Added to CAL_gsi_cornering_limit while upshift advice is shown. Was CAL_slip_inhibit_cornering_offset.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Steering term = gsi_steering_rate * cal / 100. Was CAL_slip_steering_rate_factor.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Cap on the steering term (used as a max, not a min). Was CAL_slip_steering_increase_factor_min.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. IIR weight (/256) of gsi_steering_rate_filter_q8. Was CAL_slip_steering_angle_smooth_factor.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Reload of gsi_pedal_applied_timer (100 ms). Was CAL_slip_inhibit_accel_pedal_timer.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Downshift when rpm < idle target - cal*5 (manual).
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Hysteresis subtracted from the min-rpm threshold before *5 (5 rpm units). Was CAL_slip_threshold_hysteresis_offset (typed 4+500).
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Reload of gsi_downshift_advisory_timer / holdoff (100 ms). Was CAL_slip_timer_intervention2.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Max gears between current and recommended gear. Was CAL_slip_tc_gear_max_step.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Margin below the current gear min rpm for downshift (5 rpm units). Was CAL_slip_threshold_rpm_margin.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Compared with accel_front_wheels for gsi_flags bits 3/4. Was CAL_slip_wheelspeed_front_accel_threshold.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Manual: speed above which 1st gear counts as moving for gsi_display_gear. Was CAL_slip_enable_speed.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. X axis (air mass since start) of CAL_gsi_coldstart_rpm_offset_manual. Was CAL_slip_comp_maf_accum_manual_X_maf_accum.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. rpm added to the per-gear min rpm when cold, vs air mass since start. Was CAL_slip_comp_maf_accum_manual.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. X axis (engine_power_corrected) of CAL_gsi_power_upshift_rpm. Was CAL_slip_power_based_rpm_thresholds_X_power.
GSI (gear shift indicator), not TC. Power-based upshift rpm vs engine power. Was CAL_slip_power_based_rpm_thresholds.
DPM slip target source: 0 pedal map only, 1 DPM level + pedal, 2 off. Was tc_slip_target_mode_state.
